verdict.rationale: Pipecat's docs include a live per-endpoint "Try it" playground for the Pipecat Cloud REST API, with generated cURL examples and runnable in-page requests. It is backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec. That directly delivers an interactive API reference with runnable examples, though only for the Cloud REST surface. missing for 10: interactive runnable reference for the Python framework API (not just Cloud REST), independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
